text:
mina: FYI: noticed small token discrepancies in invoice preview after the new routing-relay landed on canary. Some sessions split across two route ids.
leo: Logs show retries add `route_hint=ephemeral` which makes route_resolution_id differ.
rebecca: That will split ledger writes. preview join currently treats different rr ids as separate buckets.
mina: Quick repro: trigger upstream 502 -> relay retries -> downstream returns alternate route_hint -> ingest shows two rr values for same session.
toni-sre: Ops can flip a relay flag to stop emitting ephemeral hints. Might be fastest mitigation.
ashley-billing: Billing concerned. Even small per-session deltas add up across many tenants. Need telemetry to decide backfill risk.
leo: Plan: 1) ingest pre-writer: map subsequent rr to first-seen rr for session_id+tenant with 3m TTL if route_hint contains "ephemeral". 2) add joiner guard to merge fragments if within 2s and total tokens small. 3) instrument `metering.split_sessions` and `metering.split_token_hist`.
rebecca: Add a unit test simulating intentional model switch so aliasing doesn't hide real route changes.
ops-bot: Incident MET-2026-150 created, assigned to @leo and @toni-sre. Priority P2.
mina: I'll coordinate with CS and devex to surface a console note for affected tenants.
leo: Pushing ingest fix branch now, will link PR in thread.
